home.hero.lead.text: Pizza, pasta and Valais wines – on the sun-drenched terrace with a clear view of the Gemmi and Torrent.

home.hero.photoCaption.text: Giardino with its playground and terrace, with Leukerbad behind

home.hero.outro.text: Pizzeria Giardino, framed by an imposing mountain backdrop, is an experience for lovers of Italian cuisine.

home.story.title.text: Giardino – the distinctive pizzeria in Leukerbad

home.story.lead.text: Bella Italia in the heart of the spa village. Surrounded by an imposing mountain backdrop, Pizzeria Giardino is an experience for lovers of Italian cuisine.

home.story.chapters.0.title.text: Wood, stone and loving attention to detail

home.story.chapters.0.body.text: Stylish elegance plays ingeniously with a cosy touch of wood, giving Giardino its unique character with a great deal of attention to detail.

home.story.chapters.1.title.text: A clear view of the Gemmi and Torrent

home.story.chapters.1.body.text: The sun-drenched terrace with a clear view of the Gemmi and Torrent makes the Italian dream complete. In summer, it is where everyone meets.

home.story.chapters.2.title.text: A real insider’s tip for families

home.story.chapters.2.body.text: For families with children, Giardino is a real insider’s tip – for the indoor and outdoor play areas alone.

home.kitchen.title.text: Fresh from the market, authentic, full of flavour.

home.kitchen.body.text: We care about this not only in the kitchen but from the moment we shop. With passion and creativity, we conjure up Italian and traditional delicacies. Our varied selection and our special children’s menu will win the hearts of gourmets big and small.

home.kitchen.facts.0.body.text: We make our pizza dough fresh on site every day, with regional ingredients.

home.kitchen.facts.1.body.text: Our bread comes from the la Bohème bakery in Leukerbad every day.

home.kitchen.facts.2.title.text: Valais wines, by the glass too

home.kitchen.facts.2.body.text: If you appreciate high quality in a lived-in atmosphere, Giardino in Leukerbad is the right place for you. Excellent Valais wines from the region and exquisite Italian wines, which we also serve by the glass, round off the pleasure.

home.kitchen.wir.text: As a 100 percent WIR business, we are also happy to accept WIR money.

home.carta.title.text: The whole menu – take your time

home.carta.body.text: Every dish, every wine and every ice cream from our menus, with prices in CHF. Searchable, easy to read on any screen – and the originals as PDFs.

home.hosts.title.text: It is nice being a guest – but feeling at home is even better!

home.hosts.quote.text: If our guests are happy and satisfied, so are we!

home.hosts.body.text: Since 2012, Pascal and Anja Loretan have carried on Giardino’s treasured tradition of hospitality as the second generation – with their young, dynamic team.

home.family.title.text: A restaurant without children’s laughter is just a place to eat…

home.family.body.text: But Giardino is a paradise for children: a playroom to let off steam, the big outdoor playground in summer – and, since summer 2016, an enormous pirate ship waiting to be conquered.

home.film.body.text: Kitchen, terrace, playground and evening atmosphere – the film of Pizzeria Giardino.

kids.title.text: A restaurant without children’s laughter is just a place to eat…

kids.p1.text: But Giardino in Leukerbad is a paradise for children. Here, you are the most important people. On our extra child-friendly menu you will find lots of yummy things to eat.

kids.p2.text: But there is a lot more to enjoy than that. So that you don’t have to sit at the table for hours, we have set up a playroom for you to run around in. And in summer you can romp about on the big outdoor playground.

kids.secret.text: Shhh! We’ll let you in on another secret: since summer 2016, there has been an enormous pirate ship out there for you to conquer.

kids.familyDestination.text: Leukerbad is a “Family Destination” – with its mascot Thermi.

hostsPage.title.text: It is nice being a guest – but feeling at home is even better!

hostsPage.p1.text: Since 2012, we, Pascal and Anja Loretan, have been carrying on the treasured, long-standing tradition of hospitality at Giardino in Leukerbad as the second generation. We are delighted to pass on the unique pleasure of pampering our guests to our two sons, Janis and Niklas – after all, the two little rascals have already taken their first tentative steps in service.

hostsPage.quote.text: If our guests are happy and satisfied, so are we!

hostsPage.p2.text: We live by this philosophy every single day with our young, dynamic team. Two of our service fairies and kitchen imps have been looking after the guests at Giardino for many years.

hostsPage.p3.text: Our hosts’ hearts beat as one. May we win you over?

hostsPage.p4.text: We look forward to your visit!

privacy.proposalSections.0.p.0.text: This website is a non-binding design proposal and not the official website of Pizzeria Giardino. Responsible for this preview: [Operator of this preview]. Pizzeria Giardino’s privacy policy is on its official website.

privacy.proposalSections.1.p.0.text: The reservation and contact forms send nothing to this website. They only prepare an email that your own email program sends to info@pizzeriagiardino.ch – and only once you send it there. This preview does not store your details.

privacy.proposalSections.2.p.0.text: This preview sets no cookies and uses no analytics, tracking or advertising services. Fonts and code come from the same server as the page.

privacy.proposalSections.3.p.0.text: Your browser stores locally (localStorage) the language you explicitly chose and, for the session (sessionStorage), a reservation request you have not sent yet, so it survives a change of language. These details never leave your device; you can delete them in your browser at any time.

privacy.proposalSections.4.p.0.text: The map (OpenStreetMap), the video (YouTube, Google) and the virtual tour (Matterport) load only when you click them. The provider then receives technical data such as your IP address, and its privacy policy applies. Links to other websites – such as the PDF menus on pizzeriagiardino.ch or the vouchers on felizzio – open that provider’s page.

privacy.proposalSections.5.p.0.text: The provider whose server hosts this preview may log technically necessary data such as IP address, time and requested address.

privacy.proposalSections.6.p.0.text: Under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) you may ask what personal data is held about you. As this preview stores no personal data, please contact Pizzeria Giardino directly with questions about a reservation.

privacy.sections.0.p.0.text: Pizzeria Giardino, Pascal & Anja Loretan, Thermenstrasse 9, 3954 Leukerbad, phone +41 (0)27 530 05 84, info@pizzeriagiardino.ch.

privacy.sections.1.p.0.text: We process personal data in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and, where applicable, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). We only process the data we need for the purpose in question and do not pass it on to third parties without your consent – except to technical service providers working on our behalf (hosting, email).

privacy.sections.2.p.0.text: When you open the website, the server automatically records technical information transmitted by your browser: browser type and version, operating system, referrer URL, host name of the accessing computer, time of the request and IP address. This information serves the secure operation of the site, is not combined with other data and is deleted after a short time.

privacy.sections.3.p.0.text: When you request a table online, we store the date, time, number of guests, seating and other requests, your name, phone number, email address and message. We use these details to process your request, contact you and confirm the reservation. The legal basis is your request or the preparation of a contract. Name, phone number, email address and message are deleted no later than 30 days after the reservation date. Please do not include any health information in the message; we are happy to discuss allergies in person.

privacy.sections.4.p.0.text: If you write to us using the contact form, we store your details, including your contact information, to process your enquiry and for any follow-up questions. The basis for this is your consent, which you can withdraw at any time by sending us an informal email. We delete the message no later than 90 days after it arrives, unless we are legally required to keep it.

privacy.sections.5.p.0.text: The website remembers your choice of language (localStorage) – but only once you choose one explicitly – and a reservation request that has not yet been sent (sessionStorage, deleted when you close the tab). No cookies are set for analytics or advertising purposes.

privacy.sections.6.p.0.text: This website does not use any analytics, tracking or advertising services, nor any social media plugins. The fonts are loaded from our own server.

privacy.sections.7.p.0.text: The rro.ch video (YouTube, Google), the virtual tour (Matterport) and the map (OpenStreetMap) are only loaded when you click on them. Only then does the respective provider receive data such as your IP address; its privacy policy applies.

privacy.sections.8.p.0.text: Gift vouchers are sold on our behalf by the felizzio service; its terms and conditions and privacy policy apply there. The operators of linked websites (e.g. Tripadvisor, Facebook, Google, hoteljob-schweiz.de, our partner hotels) are responsible for them.

privacy.sections.9.p.0.text: For security reasons, the website uses SSL/TLS encryption. You can recognise an encrypted connection by the “https://” and the padlock symbol in your browser’s address bar. Complete protection of data against access by third parties is not possible on the internet.

privacy.sections.10.p.0.text: You have the right at any time to obtain information free of charge about the origin, recipients and purpose of your stored personal data, and to have it corrected, deleted or handed over in a common format. You can withdraw any consent you have given at any time. To do so, please contact us at the address above. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority (in Switzerland: the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner, FDPIC).

privacy.sections.11.p.0.text: We hereby object to the use of the contact details published in our imprint for sending unsolicited advertising and information material.
